profile.headline: Full Stack UI Developer | Angular, React, Node.js | 6+ Years Experience | Building Scalable & Responsive Web Apps
profile.summary: Results-driven UI Developer with 6+ years of experience building responsive, cross-browser, and cross-platform web applications using modern front-end technologies. Expertise in Angular (v4–v16), React.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with deep understanding of state management (Redux, NGRX), RESTful APIs, and Agile development. Proven success in improving performance, code reusability, and UX. Collaborative, detail-oriented, and focused on delivering clean, scalable code within CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Led development of scalable UI components using Angular 16, optimizing performance and user experience.• Built real-time flight booking components that reduced customer support queries by 30%.
•	Enhanced asynchronous operations by utilizing advanced RxJS operators like switchMap and forkJoin.• Collaborated with QA to automate regression tests using Jasmine and Protractor.
•	Implemented secure JWT-based authentication and Angular route guards to enforce user access control.• Implemented AG Grid for high-performance tabular data display and interaction.
•	Reduced initial load time by 40% through lazy loading modules and code splitting strategies.• Mentored junior developers on Angular best practices and performance tuning.
•	Integrated cloud services using AWS Lambda and S3, contributing to high availability deployments.
•	Managed CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, ensuring zero-downtime rollouts and improved release cycles.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
API integration.• Refactored legacy React codebase, improving maintainability and reducing bugs by 20%.
•	Utilized React Hooks to manage application state, improving code reusability and performance.• Integrated third-party chart libraries (D3.js) to visualize financial data interactively.
•	Improved page responsiveness using Bootstrap and CSS Grid/Flexbox for cross-browser support.• Automated component testing in CI pipeline using Jest and GitHub Actions.
•	Collaborated with backend teams to streamline API consumption and ensure data consistency.• Redesigned user workflows, enhancing usability and reducing task completion time.
•	Wrote unit tests using Jest and Enzyme, achieving 95%+ test coverage across components.
•	Contributed to Agile sprints and facilitated daily standups, retrospectives, and sprint planning.

positions.title: Front End/UI Developer
positions.description:
•	Built responsive user interfaces using Angular 7 and Bootstrap for solar energy dashboards.• Integrated Angular forms with advanced validation logic and user feedback mechanisms.
•	Created dynamic forms and services with RxJS for real-time data updates and efficiency.• Built shared modules for component reuse across multiple business units.
•	Improved code maintainability by modularizing UI components and services.• Collaborated with DevOps to containerize the application using Docker.
•	Participated in Agile rituals and implemented backlog grooming techniques for sprint efficiency.• Improved SEO and accessibility compliance using Angular meta service and ARIA roles.
•	Conducted detailed code reviews to uphold best practices in Angular and TypeScript.
•	Streamlined API interactions through custom interceptors and error handling mechanisms.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and built React.js components with emphasis on reusability and modularity.• Created performance dashboards using React and integrated real-time data feeds.
•	Integrated Firebase Authentication and implemented JWT for session security.• Participated in user research and incorporated feedback into UI enhancements.
•	Optimized front-end build pipelines using Webpack and Babel for faster deployments.• Configured ESLint and Prettier to enforce code consistency across teams.
•	Connected REST APIs using Axios and Fetch, managing complex data states efficiently.• Developed internal tools using React and Firebase to streamline operations.
•	Built responsive layouts with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript tailored for mobile-first design.
•	Coordinated with design teams to implement accessible and user-friendly interfaces.
